sections.normalized_html: EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
First, we will construct the point-slope form of the line. Then, we will simplify it into standard form.

[MATH: \underbrace{2x - y}_{\textrm{variables}} \quad = \underbrace{-5\phantom{y}}_{\textrm{constant}}]

Item 2 — Example: Identifying Equations Written in Standard Form
